verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships AI features (First Pass AI, GenAI DDQ, an AI Helpbot), so whether customer data is used for model training is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack contains no statement on training-data use, no opt-out control, and no contractual no-training commitment. The AI Helpbot transparency article only says the bot answers from approved support content; it says nothing about how customer data is handled for training.
